headline: Conoil Profit Rises Sixfold in Nine Months
summary: Nigerian oil firm Conoil Plc reported a sixfold increase in profit after tax for the nine months ending September 2026, supported by stronger revenue and lower costs.
why: Conoil is a major player in the Nigerian downstream oil sector, and its earnings are sensitive to energy market conditions.

impacts.name: Conoil
impacts.why: Substantial profit growth is a strong positive signal for shareholders.
